format: Single traditional Restaurant (typically 1,800 to 2,500 sq ft, leased; retail strip malls, urban areas, shopping centers)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Blaze Pizza restaurant is between $757,000 and $1,297,100. This includes $30,000 to $40,000 that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliate(s).

fee.quote: An Initial Franchise Fee of $30,000 is payment for all of our pre-opening assistance that we provide to allow you to open your Restaurant. The Initial Franchise Fee is non-refundable, uniform, and payable in a lump-sum when you sign each Franchise Agreement.
fee.note: No reduced fees collected last fiscal year; no veteran discount printed. Area Development Agreement: Development Fee of $10,000 per Restaurant after the first, credited $10,000 against each subsequent fee. Grand opening advertising minimum $10,000.

royalty.quote: Continuing Royalty(2) 5% of Gross Sales Due on Wednesday of each week

adFund.quote: Creative Fund Contribution(2) Up to 4% of weekly Gross Sales (currently 2% of weekly Gross Sales)
adFund.note: Creative Fund currently 2%, up to 4% on 60 days' notice. Local Advertising Requirement: 2% of Gross Sales over each rolling 6-month period (shortfall payable to the Creative Fund).

otherRecurring.name: Technology Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Up to $300 per month (not increased more than 3% in any given year)

otherRecurring.name: Loyalty Platform Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Actual costs charged by our vendor, currently $126 per month per Restaurant

otherRecurring.name: Reputation Management Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Actual costs, currently $38 per month per Restaurant

otherRecurring.name: Training Software License and MDM License Fees
otherRecurring.amount: $30 per Training Tablet per month (total of $60) plus MDM license fees of $4 per Training Tablet and per Online Ordering Tablet per month

otherRecurring.name: Mystery Shops
otherRecurring.amount: Standard program: $25 per mystery shop for each of 11 written mystery shops and 1 video mystery shop annually

transferFee.amount: 50% of our then-current initial franchise fee per Restaurant ($1,000 non-refundable deposit at time of transfer application submittal); transfer to a controlled entity: actual costs up to $5,000

item19.quote: Of the 208 2025 Franchised Restaurants operated from Traditional Locations, 84 or 40% attained or surpassed the average Gross Sales of $1,341,998 in 2025, the median Gross Sales was $1,225,848, the low Gross Sales was $378,061, and the high Gross Sales was $3,361,445.
item19.note: Sales only, no costs. Excludes 6 Non-Traditional and 2 food court Restaurants, and 38 franchised Restaurants that closed during 2025. No company-owned Restaurants at 2025 fiscal year end.

special: Franchisor primarily sells multi-unit Area Development Agreements; transfers of single Restaurants are restricted (owners of 3 or fewer must transfer all; more than 3 at least 50%). System shrank from 303 to 230 outlets over 2023-2025, with 38 franchised closures in 2025; all company Restaurants were refranchised or closed in 2025.
issues: Transfer fee not printed in dollars (50% of $30,000 implies $15,000). Technology Fee is printed only as a maximum ('Up to $300 per month'). Item 19 text writes the average as '$1,341, 998' with a broken space.
